page.layout: Top of page: running head centred above the text. Left column: German heading paragraph, then a woodcut of a shrimp-like crustacean, then an italic Latin paragraph below the woodcut. Right side: a caption at top right above a large woodcut of a crustacean with long antennae. Lower part of the page is cut off in this part.

main_text.l: GERM. Ein besondere art der kleinen
Meer=krebsen/ die man Gernier nennet/ sollend im Teütschē
meer zimlich groß werden: an s farb weyß oder weyß

l.i: Iconē hanc eiusdem, ni fallor, Squillæ, Venetijs accepi: pictur am minorem esse
putauissem, & caudam minus directam, ut cognomini responderet. Sed diligentius
considerari debet. nam Rondeletius Gibbæ suæ pedes omnes in summo diui-
sos facit: hæc suis pedibus ad Crangonem propius accedit.

main_text.l: à Cor. Sittard. ad nos missa.

page.notes: The woodcut of the shrimp and the large right-hand woodcut are figures, not text. The caption "Eiusdem alia icon à Cor. Sittard. ad nos missa." stands at top right beside the large woodcut and is given as a foot line. Some letters in the German and Latin lines are uncertain, notably "s" in "an s farb" and "pictura" (printed "pictuam"). The lower half of the page is not in this part.
